item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Korea10K establishes a high-resolution genomic and multiomic reference for the Korean population and reveals a previously unrecognized interaction between genetic variation and epigenomic measurement. item.description: CONCLUSION: The findings highlight information access and use, AI tool accessibility, output verification, and self-advocacy as specialised AI literacy domains for people with VI. Profile-based training, appropriate educational infrastructure, and accessibility verification systems are needed to accommodate differences in visual impairment and primary access media.

item.description: CONCLUSION: In this Korean real-world cohort of patients with stage IV epithelial OC, frontline bevacizumab maintenance monotherapy did not demonstrate a clear PFS benefit. Further prospective studies are warranted to better define the role of bevacizumab in ethnically diverse populations and optimize maintenance strategies in advanced OC.

item.description: CONCLUSIONS: This Phase 1 clinical trial supports the short-term safety and tolerability of single intravenous administration of WJ-MSCs in patients with CMT1A. item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Significant sex-specific differences in long-term body composition and lipid profile outcomes were observed after gastrectomy. Women experienced persistent muscle loss and limited improvement in lipid profiles compared to men. These findings support the need for sex-specific postoperative care to prevent sarcopenia and optimize long-term metabolic health and quality of life.

item.description: CONCLUSION: Adenomyosis significantly impacts fertility, necessitating standardised diagnostic criteria and individualised management strategies. Further randomised controlled trials are essential to refine treatment protocols and improve reproductive success rates.

item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Conscientious objection to euthanasia cannot be reduced to a fixed, categorical stance; it is a dynamic, context-sensitive practice. Ethical guidance and policy should recognize its relational and interpretive dimensions. Dialogue between theoretical and empirical accounts is needed to develop a comprehensive understanding of conscientious objection as a lived moral practice.

item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Aortic arch reconstruction using a fan-shaped autologous pulmonary artery patch is technically feasible in selected infants with coarctation of the aorta associated with marked arch hypoplasia. Long-term follow-up is required to evaluate durability and late outcomes.
